source_tamil_lines: பொய்மொழி பேசி பலர் பெண் கொள்ள வந்திடுவார்
நல்ல விலை பேசுவார் நாளும் சுமந்து பெற்றோர்கள் (திரு)
english_lines: Condition, decide it for yourself, dear!— (Thiru)
Speaking false words, many will come seeking to take a bride,
The parents who carried and bore you will bargain day after day for a good price. (Thiru)
They will value you like straw—and before your eyes,
Point out who is to be the wedding bridegroom,
Dear, here is a message for you—these
Marriage brokers need not be feared. (Thiru)
notes: The song's critique of marriage bargaining and brokerage is kept direct rather than softened into generic advice.
`புல்லென` is retained as the concrete comparison `like straw`.
The source refrain cue `(திரு)` is retained as `(Thiru)` rather than expanded.

translator_notes: The source explicitly labels this a radio song; that performance label is preserved.
